upi.title: UPI & QR Safety
upi.subtitle: Review payment details before paying. This check cannot verify an account owner or guarantee a transaction is safe.
upi.emptyResult: Enter the payment details and review them. A valid-looking UPI ID does not prove the recipient is trustworthy.
upi.disclaimer: Never share your UPI PIN. This app does not contact a bank, verify a recipient, or initiate a transaction.
upi.scanUnavailable: This browser cannot open the selected QR image. Try choosing a PNG or JPEG image.
upi.noQrFound: No QR code could be decoded from that image.
upi.notUpiQr: The decoded QR code does not contain a supported UPI payment address.
upi.scanFailed: The QR image could not be read. Choose a clear image and try again.

reasons.RECIPIENT_MISSING: Enter the recipient name; it cannot be confirmed from this form.
reasons.RECIPIENT_INVALID: Enter a recipient name containing letters or numbers, no longer than 100 characters.
reasons.UPI_ID_INVALID: The UPI ID format does not look valid. Check it with the recipient through a trusted channel.
reasons.AMOUNT_MISSING: Enter the amount you intend to pay.
reasons.AMOUNT_INVALID: Enter a valid amount greater than zero, with no more than two decimal places.
reasons.RECIPIENT_UNVERIFIED: The details indicate an unknown or unverified recipient. Confirm independently before paying.
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_PAYMENT_REQUEST: The payment information asks for a PIN, OTP, or suspicious advance fee. Do not proceed.
reasons.LOCAL_FORMAT_CHECKS_PASSED: The entered fields passed basic local format checks only.
reasons.RECIPIENT_NOT_VERIFIED: Recipient identity and account ownership have not been verified. Confirm the displayed name in your trusted payment app.

detector.title: Scam Detector
detector.subtitle: Check phone numbers, messages, and links before you trust them.
detector.defaultFinding: No obvious issue found. This does not prove the sender or website is genuine.
detector.defaultAction: Stay alert and verify before sharing personal information.

reasons.INVALID_LENGTH: The number does not match a normal mobile-length pattern.
reasons.REPEATED_DIGITS: The number repeats the same digit several times.
reasons.LONG_REPEATED_SEQUENCE: The number contains a long repeated-digit sequence.
reasons.SEQUENTIAL_DIGITS: The number follows a sequential pattern that looks artificial.
reasons.UNUSUAL_FORMAT: The number format is unusual for a normal Indian mobile number.
reasons.LOCAL_REPORT_MATCH: This matches a locally reported item.
reasons.VALID_FORMAT_NO_EVIDENCE: The number has a valid-looking structure, but there is no strong evidence of legitimacy.
reasons.HTTP_INSTEAD_OF_HTTPS: The link does not use HTTPS encryption.
reasons.IP_ADDRESS_INSTEAD_OF_DOMAIN: The link uses an IP address instead of a regular domain name.
reasons.SHORTENED_URL: The link is shortened, which can hide the real destination.
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_TLD: The domain uses a suspicious top-level domain.
reasons.UNUSUALLY_LONG_URL: The URL is unusually long and may be hiding additional content.
reasons.URL_USERNAME_TRICK: The URL contains a misleading username-like pattern.
reasons.HIGH_RISK_PAGE_TYPE: The URL points to a page that commonly requests account or verification details.
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_KEYWORDS: The URL contains security-related and phishing-style wording.
reasons.LOOKALIKE_OR_EXCESSIVE_SUBDOMAINS: The domain structure looks like a lookalike or excessive subdomain arrangement.
reasons.LONG_QUERY_STRING: The link contains a long query string that may hide tracking or phishing actions.
reasons.SENSITIVE_PATH_PATTERN: The destination path looks like a sensitive login or verification page.
reasons.BRAND_IMPERSONATION_RISK: The link appears to imitate a brand but does not match the official domain.
reasons.INVALID_URL: The URL could not be parsed correctly.
reasons.NO_MAJOR_TECHNICAL_RED_FLAGS: No major technical red flags were detected, but this is not proof of legitimacy.
reasons.OTP_REQUEST: The message asks for an OTP or verification code.
reasons.UPI_PIN_REQUEST: The message asks for a UPI PIN or pin code.
reasons.PASSWORD_REQUEST: The message asks for a password or login credentials.
reasons.BANK_INFO_REQUEST: The message requests banking or card details.
reasons.PAYMENT_REQUEST: The message asks for a payment or money transfer.
reasons.URGENT_LANGUAGE: The message uses urgency to pressure you into acting quickly.
reasons.THREAT_LANGUAGE: The message uses fear or threats to create urgency.
reasons.PRIZE_SCAM: The message makes an unrealistic prize or reward claim.
reasons.KYC_SCAM: The message asks for identity verification or KYC details.
reasons.DELIVERY_SCAM: The message resembles a parcel or delivery scam.
reasons.REMOTE_ACCESS_REQUEST: The message requests remote access or screen sharing.
reasons.IMPERSONATION: The message may be impersonating an organization or official service.
reasons.JOB_SCAM: The message makes an unrealistic job or income promise.
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_LINK: The message includes a suspicious or risky link.
reasons.SHORTENED_URL: The message contains a shortened URL.
reasons.SENSITIVE_INFO_WITH_URGENCY: The message combines sensitive information requests with urgency.
reasons.NO_MAJOR_RISK_INDICATORS: No major risk indicators were detected. This does not prove the message is genuine.
